The consumer declares this direct dependency. The current supplier file items/def-feedforward-neural-network.md was read in full; it is a draft definition with deps: []. Exact relevant supplier excerpt: Each non-input vertex $v$ has a real bias $b_v$, a real weight $w_{uv}$ for every edge $u\to v$, and a real activation function $\rho_v$. In the specified order, its value is
$$z_v=\rho_v\!\left(b_v+\sum_{u:\,u\to v}w_{uv}z_u\right).$$
A layered multilayer perceptron is the specialization with layers $V_0,\ldots,V_L$, where $V_0=I$, $V_L=O$, and every edge goes from $V_{\ell-1}$ to $V_\ell$ for some $\ell$; the hidden vertices use a shared activation and the output vertices use the identity activation. The consumer uses this only for finite encoder/decoder map notation (and, for the example, constant network maps). No universal-approximation result is used. Interface inspection is recorded; no owner acceptance or independent review is claimed.

The consumer declares this direct dependency. The population-risk inputs are random images on a probability space. The published supplier items/def-probability-measure.md was read. Exact relevant supplier excerpt: A **probability measure** on a measurable space $(X,\mathcal A)$ is a measure $\mathbb P$ with $\mathbb P(X)=1$ ([[def-measure]]). The triple $(X,\mathcal A,\mathbb P)$ is a **probability space** ([[def-measure-space]]); $X$ is its sample space and the members of $\mathcal A$ are its events.

The consumer declares this direct dependency. The population losses are nonnegative measurable random variables, so the nonnegative expectation clause defines an extended-valued risk. The published supplier items/def-expectation-of-a-nonnegative-or-integrable-random-variable.md was read. Exact relevant supplier excerpt: - If $X:\Omega\to[0,+\infty]$ is measurable, its **expectation** is the
  extended-valued integral
  $$\mathbb E[X]:=\int_\Omega X\,d\mathbb P\in[0,+\infty].$$
- If $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ or $X:\Omega\to\mathbb C$ is integrable in the sense
  of [[def-integrable-real-and-complex-functions-and-their-integrals]], its
  **expectation** is again
  $$\mathbb E[X]:=\int_\Omega X\,d\mathbb P,$$
  now a finite real or complex number.

The consumer names the sigma-algebras that equip its image and latent spaces. The published supplier items/def-sigma-algebra.md was read. Exact relevant supplier excerpt: A **sigma-algebra on $X$** is an algebra of subsets
$\mathcal A$ ([[def-algebra-of-subsets]]) that is closed under countable unions:
whenever $(A_n)_{n\in\mathbb N}$ is a sequence in $\mathcal A$,

$$\bigcup_{n\in\mathbb N}A_n\in\mathcal A.$$
